name: Nissan / Infiniti (Consult I, pre-OBD)
notes: Consult I protocol per the open-source OpenConsult project (github.com/jonsim/openconsult). Grey 14-pin connector, 1989-2000. Needs a Consult cable on a serial port at 9600 baud. Read-only: clearing codes is not implemented. Not yet validated on a vehicle.
provenance: Derived from the public OpenConsult project and community notes.
